newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stena Line 9mth passenger volumes up 8pct.
newsitem.headline: Stena Line 9mth passenger volumes up 8pct.

text.p: Swedish ferry operator Stena Line said on Tuesday its total passenger volumes had increased by eight percent to 13 million in the first nine months of 1996.
It said passenger volumes on Stena Line's Dover-Calais services had increased by 52 percent over the same period.

"Capacity increases together with Eurotunnel's halving of prices before the summer season has meant that the Dover-Calais line has attracted volumes from other lines over the English Channel," Stena Lin said in a statement.
Exlcluding this route, Stena Line's total volumes to and from Britain had fallen during the first nine months of the year, it said.

The total number of passenger cars carried by Stena Line ferries had increased by eight percent, the company said in a statement, to 2.2 million, whilst freight volumes were unchanged at 698,000 units.
